title: Magic Hood
description:
The Magic Hood can be worn as a helmet and has 2 effects:

- In Multiplayer your player name does not render, whether you are crouching or not.

- You emit no potion particles.

As armor it has the same protection, toughness and enchantability as chain armor, but only the durability of a leather helmet.

It cannot be crafted. It can be found in dungeon chests (5% chance) & village weaponsmith chests (15% chance). Both can be turned off in the config.

properties.label: Config
properties.value: MagicHood (default true) - adds the hood to dungeon and village chests
